title: Admin: Edit, Delete, and Mark Paintings as Sold with Visual Indicators

requirements.text: Add backend support for updating an existing painting's fields (title, description, price, images, sold status) via an admin-only update function. Ensure delete and sold-status toggle operations are also available as admin-only backend calls.

quotes: edit any current painting, delete the post, or label it as sold

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can update all fields of an existing painting by ID
Admin can delete a painting by ID
Admin can toggle or set the sold status of a painting by ID
Non-admin callers are rejected with an authorization error for all three operations

requirements.text: In the AdminPaintingList component, ensure each painting row displays clearly functional Edit, Delete, and Mark as Sold/Available action buttons. The Edit action should open the AdminPaintingForm pre-populated with the existing painting data. The Delete action should show a confirmation dialog before permanently removing the painting. The Mark as Sold toggle should immediately update the painting's sold status.

quotes: admin to be able to edit any current painting, delete the post, or label it as sold

acceptanceCriteria: Edit button opens the painting form with all existing fields pre-filled
Submitting the edit form updates the painting and refreshes the list
Delete button shows a confirmation dialog; confirming removes the painting from the list
Mark as Sold/Available button toggles the sold status and the UI reflects the new state immediately
All actions are only visible to authenticated admin users

requirements.text: Display a prominent visual SOLD indicator on sold paintings in both the public gallery and the painting detail page. This should include a bold diagonal 'SOLD' stamp overlay on the painting's primary image and a SOLD badge near the title or price with a strikethrough on the price. The AdminPaintingList table should also show a clear sold/available status label per row.

quotes: label it as sold with visual graphics to show users it's sold

acceptanceCriteria: Sold paintings in the public gallery grid show a diagonal SOLD stamp overlay on the image
Sold paintings show a SOLD badge and a strikethrough price on the PaintingCard
The PaintingDetailPage shows a SOLD badge and strikethrough price for sold paintings
The AdminPaintingList table clearly shows the sold/available status for each painting
Available paintings do not show any sold indicators

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
All backend logic must remain in the single main actor file (backend/main.mo)
Edit, delete, and sold-toggle operations must be restricted to admin-role principals only
nonGoals: Public users cannot edit, delete, or change sold status of paintings
No bulk operations (e.g., bulk delete or bulk mark as sold)
No image hosting changes or external media integrations
